places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake lives with Lorena above the Dry Bean while new hands play cards there; on a hot day Augustus wins a cut of cards and buys Lorena's favors.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; Lorena's room is above the Dry Bean saloon

places.name: Hat Creek cow camp
places.note: The outfit has been gathering and branding cattle for about ten days; Call has put Jake to work there.
places.location_hint: somewhere near Lonesome Dove, location not given

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Xavier has gone fishing there, leaving the saloon nearly empty.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena means to hold Jake to his promise to take her there; Augustus doubts Jake will follow through.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Needle Nelson comes from north of it; Lorena considers ordering new dresses from there.

places.name: Brownsville
places.note: Hometown of the cheerful new hand Bert Borum.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Needle frets they'll cross it on ice if they don't start soon; Jasper expects drownings before then.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Lorena cites the man Jake killed there; Augustus calls it a stray shot that hit a dentist.

groups.label: Dry Bean saloon
groups.hint: in Lorena's room and the saloon at the Dry Bean

groups.label: Cattle crew
groups.hint: gathering and branding cattle near Lonesome Dove ahead of the drive
